name: Mindomo
description_en:
Mindomo is a visual thinking and planning application combining mind maps, concept maps, outlines and Gantt views. It supports manual structure, AI-assisted drafting and online collaboration, with desktop and mobile options.

Views can share the same topics, but export, guest editing and planning rights vary by plan. AI-generated structure remains material to question and revise rather than an authoritative explanation.
description_zh:
Mindomo 是结合脑图、概念图、大纲和甘特视图的可视化思考规划应用，支持手动结构、AI 起草和在线协作，并有桌面移动选项。

视图可共享主题，但导出、访客编辑及规划权益随套餐不同。AI 结构仍需质疑修改，不能当权威解释。

sections.title_en: One topic structure across several views
sections.title_zh: 多种视图共用主题结构
sections.en: The homepage describes starting from a blank map, text, imports or AI, adding labeled relationships, reorganizing branches and using an outline or Gantt view. Desktop apps are advertised for offline work on Windows, macOS and Linux. Online collaboration and offline desktop operation should be checked as separate workflows, including how edits return to the shared version.
sections.zh: 首页介绍从空白、文字、导入或 AI 开始，添加带标签关系、重组分支，并切到大纲或甘特图。桌面版宣传可在 Windows、macOS、Linux 离线使用。在线协作和离线桌面应分别检查，包括编辑如何返回共享版本。

sections.title_en: Example: move a project outline into a schedule
sections.title_zh: 示例：把项目大纲转成计划
sections.en: Create branches for research, build and review, then add dates and dependencies only to items intended as tasks. Switch views and confirm that topic names and hierarchy remain consistent. Export the required format and reopen it in the destination tool before replacing the original workflow. A supported format list is not proof that all styles, links or task semantics round-trip unchanged. No map was exported here.
sections.zh: 建立研究、开发和审核分支，仅对需要成为任务的项目添加日期依赖。切换视图并核对名称层级，再导出所需格式，在目标工具重开后才考虑替换原流程。格式支持不证明样式、链接和任务语义往返完全一致。本文未导出脑图。

sections.title_en: Free diagrams, AI credits and guest rights
sections.title_zh: 免费图数、AI credits 及访客权
sections.en: The comparison gives Free three diagrams and one test AI credit, while paid Premium/Professional have unlimited diagrams. Premium lists 50 AI credits per subscription month and ten export formats; Professional adds five guests, Gantt charts and a broader export list. The page exposes multiple currency/discount figures together, so no single monthly cash rate is normalized. Its FAQ says subscriptions are prepaid and do not automatically renew; verify that condition at the actual checkout.
sections.zh: 对照表给 Free 三张图及一个 AI 测试 credit，付费 Premium/Professional 图数不限。Premium 每订阅月 50 AI credits、十种导出，Professional 增加五名访客、甘特图和更多导出格式。页面同时显示多币种及折扣金额，因此不标准化单一月价。FAQ 写预付订阅且不自动续费，实际结账仍需确认。

sections.title_en: Keep the original structure and sharing rules
sections.title_zh: 保留原始结构及分享规则
sections.en: Start with a Free map and representative import, then pilot collaborator rights and an offline edit before expanding. Mindomo can suit learning outlines, workshops and project planning; it does not validate source facts or task estimates. The website describes German hosting and daily backups, but contractual residency and successful restoration were not verified. Exact service/source licensing, AI retention and concurrent edit recovery remain unknown.
sections.zh: 先用免费脑图及代表性导入，再试点协作者权限和离线编辑。它适合学习大纲、研讨及项目规划，但不会验证来源事实或任务估算。网站介绍德国托管及每日备份，本文未确认合同驻留或实际恢复。服务源码许可、AI 保留和并发编辑恢复仍未知。
